question:
In GPU Microarchitecture and Execution Model, what failure mode triggers the following observed symptom?
"Edge case trigger: 'Fix'"

options.text: Reorganize data or thread assignments so that branching evaluates uniformly across all 32 threads in a warp (threadIdx.x / 32).
Quantize the grid dimensions to a multiple of the SM count so no wavefront tail leaves SMs idle.
Pad shared-memory array strides to avoid bank conflicts across threads in the same warp.
Increase the thread block size to raise occupancy and hide memory latency.

explanation: Diagnostic Analysis: Reorganize data or thread assignments so that branching evaluates uniformly across all 32 threads in a warp (threadIdx.x / 32).

question:
In GPU Microarchitecture and Execution Model, what failure mode triggers the following observed symptom?
"Edge case trigger: 'Root Cause'"

options.text: Conditionals inside thread blocks depending on threadIdx.x % 2 or threadIdx.x % 4.
The number of thread blocks in the grid is not a multiple of the number of streaming multiprocessors.
Threads in the same warp access shared-memory addresses that map to the same bank.
Too few resident warps per SM to hide memory latency, caused by excessive register usage per thread.

explanation: Diagnostic Analysis: Conditionals inside thread blocks depending on threadIdx.x % 2 or threadIdx.x % 4.

question:
In GPU Microarchitecture and Execution Model, what failure mode triggers the following observed symptom?
"Edge case trigger: 'Diagnosis'"

options.text: Check smspwarpexecutionefficiency.pct in NCU. If it is below 80%, intra-warp branching is serializing execution.
Check the SM occupancy timeline in Nsight Systems; a long idle tail where only one or two SMs stay active indicates a grid-quantization effect.
Check l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu in NCU; a high count indicates shared-memory bank conflicts.
Check achieved_occupancy against theoretical_occupancy in NCU; a wide gap indicates register or shared-memory pressure limiting resident warps.

explanation: Diagnostic Analysis: Check smspwarpexecutionefficiency.pct in NCU. If it is below 80%, intra-warp branching is serializing execution.
